configuration.needs_review_rule: Any of four confidence values below 0.60, or topic other, or intent unclear

offline_warm_replay.method: Read-only SQLite replay of saved labels, canonical source identity, and exact evidence. No ingestion or model execution.

scope: Supplied 100-review cost sample only; full-corpus classification, evaluation, grouping, and memo were not run.
limitations: Cost is computed from returned usage at the published rate; the account debit was not independently checked.
Summed request time is not total wall time. The runner did not persist cold wall time.
Labels and evidence have not been verified against human answers; structural checks do not establish semantic accuracy.
Summed evidence attempt time is not total evidence wall time; evidence token usage and any account debit were not measured.
The offline warm replay made no model requests and is not the required end-to-end warm pilot measurement.
Replay wall times are one local two-pass measurement, not a stable performance benchmark.
Saved evidence spans two prompt versions; the original local databases and outputs were not rewritten.
